candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly for Hindi text fragments, Devanagari script characters, and associated subword tokens.
This vector is related to common Devanagari conjunct consonants and word endings in Hindi.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and characters commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari text.
This vector activates for common Hindi pronouns, demonstratives, and related oblique case suffixes.
This feature vector represents common suffixes and character n-grams characteristic of Hindi text.
This vector activates for common Hindi suffixes and subword tokens written in the Devanagari script.
This vector represents character n-grams and subword units commonly found in Hindi script and Indic languages.
This vector represents sub-word tokens and character fragments from various non-English scripts and multilingual text encodings.
This vector activates for sequential or closely related numbers.
This vector activates on various alphanumeric tokens, fragments, and scripts associated with medical terminology and multilingual text processing.
